parameters.name: PrimaryZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID of the primary zone for a multi-zone instance. **This parameter is required if you want to create a multi-zone instance.**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: SecondaryZoneId
parameters.description:
The secondary zone ID.
> This parameter cannot be set to the same value as ZoneId.

parameters.name: SwitchMode
parameters.description:
The switchover mode. Valid values:

- 0: immediately switches over.
- 1: switches over within the O&M window.

parameters.name: TertiaryZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID for Three-zone deployment.

parameters.name: TopologyType
parameters.description:
The topology type. Valid values:

- **3azones**: three-zone deployment.
- **1azone**: single-zone deployment.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the access endpoint resides.

parameters.name: VswitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is required when you create a DRDS instance of the VPC network type.
